detail.longDescription: STEArcade is a batch of recently ported arcade games able to run on the unexpanded 8MHz Atari STE computer. Current list of games: Donkey Kong, 1942, Galaga, Black Tiger, Commando, Gun.Smoke, Gauntlet, Kung-Fu Master, Trojan, Gyruss, 1943, Bubble Bobble, R-Type, Double Dragon, Splatterhouse, Galaga '88, Mr. HELI no Daibouken, Pac-Mania, Dragon Spirit, Track & Field, Hyper Sports (some in development) https:// github.com/AnimaInCorpore/STEA rcade/tree/master # AtariST # AtariSTE # Atari # gaming # retrogaming # retrogames # vintagecomputing # retrocomputing # github
